I am an old man, 58 years, with no schooling, and this plot is not even mine — I am renting it. In Tabora here, the rain comes once and the dry season is long, so I must work with what God gives. I cannot waste money on fertilizer for land that is not mine, and the shop prices are too high for a poor man. I will plant my own seed that I saved from last season, weed with my hoe, and pay two or three young men to help me during the heavy work when my back is tired.
